name: langchain-salesforce
headline: AutoGroq: Dynamic AI Agent Teams for Efficiency
short_description: AutoGroq creates dynamic teams of AI agents tailored to project needs, streamlining workflows for sales teams. It connects to ChatGPT and Claude, automating tasks and enhancing efficiency in project management.
author: jgravelle

sections.overview:
AutoGroq is a tool that automatically creates dynamic teams of AI agents customized to your specific project requirements. Rather than manually configuring individual agents, AutoGroq analyzes your needs and assembles a coordinated team equipped to handle your task. The platform supports dynamic model selection per agent and includes skill generation capabilities to expand agent functionality. It streamlines workflows by eliminating the setup overhead typically required when working with multiple AI assistants. AutoGroq addresses the challenge of coordinating multiple AI tools by automatically building the right team composition for your use case.
Generate tailored AI teams for targeted marketing campaigns to optimize outreach and engagement.
Automate project management tasks, such as scheduling and resource allocation, to save time and reduce errors.
Enhance customer support by deploying specialized AI agents that can address specific inquiries and issues.
Streamline sales processes by configuring dynamic agents that can assist with lead generation and follow-ups.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install jgravelle/AutoGroq`
`git clone https://github.com/jgravelle/AutoGroq`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
